#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>

using namespace std;

const double eps = 1e-8;
const double PI = acos(-1.0);

struct Point {
    double x, y;

    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double xx, double yy) : x(xx), y(yy) {}

    Point add(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(x + o.x, y + o.y);
    }

    Point sub(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(x - o.x, y - o.y);
    }

    Point rotate(double alpha) const {
        double c = cos(alpha);
        double s = sin(alpha);
        return Point(x * c - y * s, x * s + y * c);
    }

    Point norm() const {
        double len = length();
        return scale(1.0 / len);
    }

    Point scale(double f) const {
        return Point(f * x, f * y);
    }

    double length() const {
        return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    }

    bool operator<(const Point& o) const {
        if (abs(x - o.x) > eps) {
            return x < o.x;
        }
        if (abs(y - o.y) > eps) {
            return y < o.y;
        }
        return false;
    }

    bool equals(const Point& o) const {
        return abs(x - o.x) < eps && abs(y - o.y) < eps;
    }

    friend ostream& operator<<(ostream& out, const Point& p) {
        out.precision(6);
        out << fixed << p.x << " " << p.y;
        return out;
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Point o;
    double r;

    bool contains(const Point& p) const {
        double dist = p.sub(o).length();
        return abs(dist - r) < eps;
    }
};

vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& c1, const Circle& c2) {
    double dx = c1.o.x - c2.o.x;
    double dy = c1.o.y - c2.o.y;
    double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    double cosVal = (c1.r * c1.r + d * d - c2.r * c2.r) / (2 * c1.r * d);
    if (cosVal < -1 - eps) {
        return {};
    }
    if (cosVal < -1) {
        cosVal = -1;
    }
    if (cosVal > 1 + eps) {
        return {};
    }
    if (cosVal > 1) {
        cosVal = 1;
    }

    vector<Point> res;
    double alpha = acos(cosVal);
    Point dir = c2.o.sub(c1.o).norm();

    res.push_back(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(+alpha)));
    res.push_back(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha)));
    return res;
}

void dfs(int i, vector<bool>& visited, const vector<set<int>>& adj) {
    visited[i] = true;
    for (int j : adj[i]) {
        if (!visited[j]) {
            dfs(j, visited, adj);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x, y, r;
        cin >> x >> y >> r;
        circles[i].o = Point(x, y);
        circles[i].r = r;
    }

    set<Point> all_points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            vector<Point> inters = intersect(circles[i], circles[j]);
            if (!inters.empty()) {
                for (const auto& p : inters) {
                    all_points.insert(p);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    map<Point, int> pointId;
    vector<set<int>> adj;

    auto getId = [&](const Point& p) {
        auto it = pointId.find(p);
        if (it == pointId.end()) {
            int sz = (int)pointId.size();
            pointId[p] = sz;
            adj.emplace_back();
            return sz;
        } else {
            return it->second;
        }
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<double> angles;
        const int K = 100;
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            angles.push_back(2 * PI * j / K);
        }
        for (const auto& p : all_points) {
            if (circles[i].contains(p)) {
                double dx = p.x - circles[i].o.x;
                double dy = p.y - circles[i].o.y;
                double alpha = atan2(dy, dx);
                if (alpha < 0) {
                    alpha += 2 * PI;
                }
                angles.push_back(alpha);
            }
        }
        sort(angles.begin(), angles.end());

        Point dir = Point(1.0, 0.0).scale(circles[i].r);
        vector<double> as;
        {
            set<double> s(angles.begin(), angles.end()); // Remove duplicates
            for (double val : s) {
                as.push_back(val);
            }
        }

        vector<Point> point_list;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < as.size(); j++) {
            Point p = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(as[j]));
            int pid = getId(p);
            point_list.push_back(p);
        }

        for (size_t j = 0; j < as.size(); j++) {
            Point p = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(as[j]));
            Point q = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(as[(j + 1) % as.size()]));
            int u = getId(p);
            int v = getId(q);
            if (u != v) {
                adj[u].insert(v);
                adj[v].insert(u);
            }
        }
    }

    int vsize = (int)pointId.size();
    int e_count = 0;
    for (const auto& sset : adj) {
        e_count += (int)sset.size();
    }
    e_count /= 2;

    int comps = 0;
    vector<bool> visited(vsize, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < vsize; i++) {
        if (!visited[i]) {
            ++comps;
            dfs(i, visited, adj);
        }
    }

    cout << 1 + comps + e_count - vsize << "\n";

    return 0;
}
